title: 不好的预感
content:
步骤一: Pick Up the 任务

  • Pick up the 任务 called "A Bad Feeling" from 塞莱斯特 at the central hub.
  • Your goal is to find and examine any ARC Probe or ARC Courier.

步骤二: Find an ARC Probe/Courier

ARC Probes and Couriers are not marked on your 地图 at first; they only show up when you get nearby.

  • One confirmed spot for an ARC Probe is near the Hydroponic Dome Complex in the 大坝战场 zone.
  • When you're near enough, the probe will show up on your 地图 as a signal marker.

步骤三: Hack and grab the Probe

  • Walk over to the ARC Probe or Courier and use it to start the "破解" process.
  • Hacking requires a brief moment, leaving you exposed meanwhile. Stay alert for threats behind you.
  • After hacking it, use it once more to "Search" the probe.
  • You usually get useful items such as ARC Alloy and ARC Performance Steel after searching.

步骤四: Finish the 任务

  • After you've examined the probe, the mission will register as finished.
  • Head back to 塞莱斯特 at the hub to claim your rewards.
  • Your rewards are Metal Parts, Steel Spring, and Duct Tape.

title: 均衡的收获
content:
This guide walks you through the "A Balanced Harvest" 任务, explaining how to find Lucille Ludi's notes to finish the task. This mission has you navigating through the Research & Administration building and find specific research project notes.

步骤一: Navigate to the Research & Administration Building

Start by opening your 地图 and locating the Research & Administration building. You can recognize it by its unique design and is near the Control Tower, as shown.

  • The structure sits in the 大坝战场 zone.
  • Find the building marked "Research & Administration" on your 地图, situated near the "Control Tower" landmark.

步骤二: Go Within the Building

Walk up to the building and find an accessible entry point. The easiest path is usually through damaged sections or openings at ground level.

  • Go into the building via the open section or damaged wall on the ground floor.
  • This way in takes you to a lower-level area, likely a reception or maintenance section.

步骤三: Climb to the Upper Floor

After entering, your goal is to arrive at the upper floor above the reception area. Use the environment to climb upwards.

  • Find the accessible elevator shaft within the building.
  • Use the shaft to climb up to the next floor.
  • When you head over to the upper floor, you'll be in what appears to be a reception or office area.
  • Turn right from the elevator shaft and continue down the corridor.
  • You'll see Lab 1 written on the wall

步骤四: Find Lucille Ludi's Notes

Move through the upper floor, following the path through the laboratory sections until you find a desk with a computer where the notes are located.

  • Keep moving through the hallways, going right when needed to progress through the lab.
  • There is the notes on a desk beside an old terminal, lit by sunlight through the big windows.

步骤五: Pick Up the Notes

After you notice Lucille Ludi's notes on the desk, walk toward them and 互动 to collect them, finishing the mission task.

  • Use the notes to pick them up.
  • Grabbing the notes will trigger the mission completion for "A Balanced Harvest."
summary: 完成Arc Raiders中"均衡的收获"任务的详细攻略，重点介绍如何在研究与管理大楼内找到并收集Lucille Ludi的笔记。

title: 更好的用途
content:
To complete 'A Better Use' 任务, you must 互动 with 补给信标s found around the 地图 and then grab the resource drops they provide.

步骤一: Find a 补给信标

  • Start by opening your 地图 to see your current missions. The 'A Better Use' 任务 will guide you to areas containing 补给信标s.
  • Identify the '补给信标' icon on your 地图. These are usually placed in certain areas for the 任务.
  • As mentioned, there is these stations in several spots, like the Village, 补给信标, or Reinforced Reception areas.

步骤二: Re任务 a resource drop

  • Go to one of the marked 补给信标 locations on the 地图.
  • When you get there, find a antenna-shaped tower. This is the 补给信标.
  • Go toward the station and press and hold the action button (E on PC) to 'REQUEST resource drop'.
  • The station then triggers a re任务 for a resource drop.

步骤三: grab the Drop

  • After re任务ing the resource drop, check the sky above. A drone will fly in and drop a supply crate.
  • Note that the resource drop might not land at the exact spot where you re任务ed it; keep an eye on where it drops.
  • After the supply crate lands, continue to its location and use it to grab what's inside.
  • Picking up the resource drop finishes the 'A Better Use' 任务.

title: 第一个据点
content:
This guide walks you through the 'A First Foothold' 任务 in Arc 突袭者, showing you the exact locations and steps needed to use four different objectives on 蓝门 地图.

步骤一: Rotate the Satellite Dish

The first objective asks you to rotate a satellite dish located on the church roof, north of the Data Vault.

  • Check your 地图 to find the church, which is north of the Data Vault.
  • Walk over to the church structure.
  • Climb the scaffolding on the side of the church to arrive at the roof.
  • After reaching the rooftop, find the satellite dish.
  • Use the satellite dish to rotate it and complete this objective.

步骤二: Nail Down the Roof Plates

For the second objective, you must nail down roof plates on a 突袭者 structure near Trapper's Glade.

  • Travel to the indicated location on your 地图, near Trapper's Glade.
  • Find the 突袭者 structure with the loose roof plates.
  • Head over to the roof plates and activate them to secure them.

步骤三: Enable the Comms Terminal

The third part of the 任务 involves enabling a comms terminal located near the Olive Grove.

  • Check your 地图 for the exact location near the Olive Grove. This objective is slightly hidden.
  • Find the comms terminal on top of a broken truck or structure.
  • Use the comms terminal to enable it.

步骤四: Stabilize the Observation Deck

The final objective is to stabilize the observation deck near Ridgeline.

  • Head over to the Ridgeline area, as shown on your 地图.
  • Find the observation deck structure.
  • Activate the yellow marker to stabilize the deck and complete the 'A First Foothold' 任务.

title: 勘察地形
content:
概述

The 'A Lay of the Land' 任务 on 太空港 asks you to find shipping notes in the Jangsu Warehouse and then retrieve LIDAR scanners from Control Tower A6, followed by 撤离.

步骤一: Find Jangsu Warehouse & Find Shipping Notes

  • Check your 地图 and find the Jangsu Warehouse in the 太空港 area.
  • Walk to the back side of the warehouse where you'll discover an entrance.
  • Go through the door and continue up the stairs.
  • On the upper part of the stairs, turn right and enter the foreman's office.
  • On the desk, you'll discover the shipping notes. 互动 to grab them.

步骤二: Head to Control Tower A6

  • After grabbing the notes, your objective will update to find the LIDAR scanners in Control Tower A6.
  • Pull up your 地图 once more to find the location of Control Tower A6. It's to the southeast of the Jangsu Warehouse.
  • Head over to Control Tower A6.

步骤三: Retrieve LIDAR Scanners

  • Once inside Control Tower A6, continue to the upper floor. There are stairs leading up.
  • On the upper floor, around a corner, you'll discover the LIDAR scanners.
  • If your 背包 is full, you may need to drop an item to pick up the scanners.

步骤四: 撤离 with LIDAR Scanners

  • After you get picked up the LIDAR scanners, your objective will update to deliver them to 斯坦尼, which has you 撤离 from the 突袭.
  • Find an 撤离 point and successfully 撤离 to finish the mission.

title: 新型植物
content:
To complete the "A New Type of Plant" 任务, you need to find and gather a specific "Possibly Toxic Plant" located in the 大坝战场 zone. This guide walks you through its exact location and how to easily turn in the 任务 item.

步骤一: Navigate to the 任务 Zone

The 任务 takes place in the 大坝战场. Pull up your 地图 to spot the general area marked as "Old Battleground" near the center of the 地图.

  • Look for the "Old Battleground" marker on your 地图 within the 大坝战场 region.
  • This area is characterized by large, crashed structures and dense foliage.

步骤二: Identify Plant Spawn Points

Once in the Old Battleground, go to the large, crashed structure that resembles a broken barn or facility.

  • The toxic plants usually spawn around the base of this massive, broken structure.
  • There are usually multiple spawn points very close to each other.
  • Keep an eye out for bright orange, somewhat spiky plants amidst the tall grass and debris.

步骤三: Gather the Plant

Move toward one of the identified toxic plants and use it to gather it.

  • Press the 互动ion button (usually 'E') when prompted to "Gather" the plant.
  • You only need one plant to turn in the mission.

步骤四: Secure and Turn In

After gathering the plant, open your 背包 and place the "Possibly Toxic Plant" into your 安全口袋.

  • Transfer the plant to your 安全口袋 to make sure it's not lost upon death.
  • To quickly turn in the mission just 撤离 and turn in
summary: 本教程解释如何在Arc Raiders的大坝战场区域"旧战场"附近有效完成"新型植物"任务，包括寻找和采集"可能有毒的植物"并上交。

title: 废墟中的发现
content:
概述

The 'A Reveal in Ruins' 任务 asks you to find an ESR Analyzer inside a pharmacy in 地下城 and deliver it to 兰斯. Pharmacies are not explicitly marked on your 地图, but they are usually found near metro stations. Here here are the exact locations of two pharmacies in 地下城 where there is the analyzer.

步骤一: Pick Up the 任务 from 兰斯

You must accept the 'A Reveal in Ruins' 任务 from 兰斯. He will task you with finding an ESR Analyzer inside a pharmacy in 地下城.

  • The 任务 objective is to find an ESR Analyzer inside any pharmacy in 地下城.
  • 兰斯 offers rewards including a Tactical MIL 3 (Healing) augment and a Surge Shield Recharger.

步骤二: Find a Pharmacy in 地下城

There are two primary pharmacy locations in 地下城 that are close to metro stations. These buildings are recognizable by a green cross symbol on their exterior.

First Pharmacy Location

The first pharmacy is close to a metro station.

  • Search nearby for a building with a green cross symbol, usually near a metro entrance.
  • On the 地图, this pharmacy is located north of Piazza Arlotto, near the Metro Entrance 路标.
  • You must 破解 the door to enter.

Second Pharmacy Location

The second pharmacy is inside a different part of 地下城.

  • This pharmacy also has a 'Farmacia' sign and a green cross symbol on its exterior.
  • On the 地图, this pharmacy is in the southern part of 地下城, near Piazza Roma and the Main Street area.
  • 破解 the door to gain entry to this building as well.

步骤三: Find and Secure the ESR Analyzer

Once inside a pharmacy, your job is to find the ESR Analyzer. It's often found on a counter or shelf.

  • Within the pharmacy, search nearby for a counter. The ESR Analyzer is a small, yellow device.
  • Use the device to pick it up.
  • CRITICAL: Immediately place the ESR Analyzer into your '安全口袋'. This ensures you don't lose the item if you get knocked out or eliminated before returning to base.

步骤四: Deliver the ESR Analyzer to 兰斯

After you've successfully securing the ESR Analyzer in your 安全口袋, you can head back to base and deliver it to 兰斯 to finish the mission.

  • Even if you are knocked out during your run, the ESR Analyzer in your 安全口袋 will be retained.
  • Head back to 兰斯 at your base.
  • Talk to 兰斯 and select the option to deliver the ESR Analyzer to finish the mission and claim your rewards.

The initial task is until you reach the Furnace Outpost, situated at the highest point of a hill on the Dam 地图.

content:

The 'A Warm Place to Rest' 任务 in Arc 突袭者 has you follow a series of clues leading to a specific location where there is a grave to inspect. Here we explain each step, from finding the initial camp to completing the 任务.

步骤一: Go to the Abandoned Highway Camp

  • Pull up your 地图 and find the '地下城' area.
  • Find the 任务 marker for 'A Warm Place to Rest' in the southwest region, in certain at the 'Abandoned Highway Camp'.
  • Head to this location.
  • When you get there, you will be on a ruined highway segment between two damaged buses.

步骤二: Follow the Red Markers

  • Near the front of one of the buses, you can find a backpack on the ground. 互动 with it to 'Search for any signs of survivors'.
  • This will trigger the next objective: 'Follow the red markers'.
  • Check your 地图 again; new red markers will now be visible, leading you towards the 'Town Hall' area. Place a 路标 to guide you.
  • Begin following these red markers along the damaged highway.
  • Continue along the path, passing various wreckage and environmental hazards.
  • The markers will lead you off the highway and down a sandy slope towards some buildings.

步骤三: Inspect the Grave

  • As you walk toward the final marker, a notification to 'Inspect the grave' will appear.
  • Find the grave site among the rocks and debris.
  • Use the grave to complete the mission 'A Warm Place to Rest'.

title: 雨后初晴
content:
In this guide, we cover the steps to successfully complete the 'After Rain Comes' 任务 in Arc 突袭者. The 任务 involves finding and repairing solar panels located near the Grandioso Apartments, requiring specific materials. You will need 5 Wires and 2 Batteries to repair the solar panels. You should bring them in with your 装备方案.

步骤一: Go to the 任务 Objective

Your first task is to head over to the correct location on the 地图.

  • Look at your 地图 to spot the 'After Rain Comes' 任务 under 地下城.
  • The objective is at the Grandioso Apartments in West Village.
  • Place a 路标 to guide you to the exact spot.

Before attempting the repair, make sure you have the needed components in your 背包.

  • These materials can usually be found by 搜刮 or 制作ed if you have the schematics and raw resources.

After you get the materials and are at the location, continue with the repair.

  • Go toward the 任务 objective marker, which will lead you to a set of solar panels on the ground.
  • Find the 互动ion point, which looks like a small yellow box near the panels.

title: 装甲运输车
content:
概述

Finding the Armored Patrol Car can be challenging due to its random spawn locations. Here you'll see where to get the needed key and all potential spawn points for the locked patrol cars in the Traffic Tunnels, helping you successfully complete the associated 任务.

步骤一: Get the Patrol Car Key

  • Start by heading to the 'Checkpoint' area on the 蓝门 地图.
  • Continue to the most left guard house within the Checkpoint area.
  • Inside, on a table, you'll discover a folder. use it to get the 'Patrol Car Key'.
  • IMPORTANT: Place the Patrol Car Key into your 安全口袋 right after. Losing this key will prevent you from completing the 任务 unless you find it again.

步骤二: Search Traffic Tunnels for Patrol Cars

  • After you get the key, walk to the Traffic Tunnels. This area is easily accessible just along the main road from the Checkpoint.
  • The Armored Patrol Cars can spawn randomly throughout the tunnels. you must check different spots.

Possible Patrol Car Locations:

  • The first possible spawn is right at the entrance of the Traffic Tunnel.
  • Check behind each armored patrol car you come across. If the rear door is locked and requires the Patrol Car Key, you've found the correct one for your 任务.
  • There are multiple spawn points deeper inside the tunnels. Consult your 地图 for general areas.
  • Continue further into the tunnel, checking both sides of the road. Be aware of ARC drones, fireball paps, and 堡垒 in this area.
  • Another common spawn point is right next to a large pillar within the tunnel.
  • Continue to the very end of the tunnel, as additional patrol cars can spawn there.
  • Note: Not all armored vehicles are the 任务-certain patrol car; some will just be junk vehicles or unlocked transports. Always look for the 互动ion prompt to use your Patrol Car Key on a locked rear door.

步骤三: Accessing the Patrol Car

  • When you find a patrol car with a locked rear door, use your Patrol Car Key to open it.
  • Inside, you'll discover weapon crates. grab these crates to receive a green or blue weapon, successfully completing the 任务.
summary: 本教程提供在Arc Raiders中找到装甲巡逻车及其钥匙的攻略。了解钥匙的位置和完成任务所需的所有巡逻车可能出现点。

title: 重回巅峰
content:
概述

To complete you must find and 互动 with specific murals or marked walls across three different 地图s: 地下城, 大坝战场, 蓝门, and Spacepoint.

步骤一: 地下城 Mural

Your first stop is the 地下城 zone. Go to the northeastern building as indicated on the 地图.

  • Find the building in the northeast section of the 地下城 zone.
  • After there, walk toward the building wall that features a distinct mural or graffiti.
  • Use this wall to finish the first part of the 任务.

步骤二: 大坝战场 Mural (Pattern House)

Next, go to the 大坝战场 地图. Your target is the Pattern House, located in the very northern part of the 地图.

  • Find the Pattern House building, which requires some climbing to go to the upper level.
  • Once inside or on the accessible part of the building, find the 互动able wall.

Continue to the 蓝门 地图. you must find a tower situated next to the Warehouse Complex.

  • Find the ladder on the side of the tower and climb it to head over to the upper sections.
  • At the top, find the wall on the tower that you can 互动 with.

步骤四: Spacepoint Mural (South Trench Tower)

Finally, walk to the Spacepoint 地图. Your objective here is the South Trench Tower.

  • Navigate to the South Trench Tower, a prominent structure nearby.
  • Find the wall on the tower that allows for 互动ion.
  • Use this final wall to successfully complete the entire 任务 line.

title: 蜜蜂！
content:
Here we walk through the precise steps to finish the 'BEES' 任务 in Arc 突袭者 by locating and grabbing the needed bees in the Olive Grove area of 蓝门. No items need to be turned in after collection.

步骤一: Head over to the 任务 Area on the 地图

  • Travel to the 'BEES' 任务 under the 'THE BLUE GATE' section in your 任务 log.
  • Observe the highlighted area on your 地图, which indicates the general vicinity of the 任务 objective. The video shows the player already at the 'Olive Grove' location.

步骤二: Pinpoint the Bee Location

After you are in the Olive Grove area, try to spot a partially ruined structure. The bees are discreetly located underneath a damaged overhang of one of these buildings.

  • Go toward the specific building shown in the video.
  • Look directly above you, underneath the structural overhang, to spot the glowing item marked as 'Collect'.
  • 互动 with the glowing item to collect the bees.

步骤三: mission completion

After grabbing the bees, the 任务 will automatically complete. You do not need to turn in any physical items to an NPC or a specific drop-off point.

  • Check your 地图 once more to confirm the 'BEES' 任务 is now marked as complete.

title: 破碎的纪念碑
content:
The 'Broken Monument' 任务 requires you to find three specific items: a Compass, a Videotape, and Old Field Rations. All of these items are found within the Scrap Yard area of the 大坝战场 地图, each hidden in small, rusted metal crates. The order in which you collect them does not matter. As you move toward a 任务 item crate, a yellow pop-up will indicate "Search for [item name]".

步骤一: Prepare for the 任务

  • Load into the 大坝战场 地图.
  • Look at your 地图 and find the Scrap Yard, which is situated at the southern end, almost in the center of the 地图, below the Research & Administration building.

步骤二: Find the Compass

title: 更晴朗的天空
content:
概述

The "Clearer Skies" 任务 has you destroying 3 ARC enemies and collect 3 ARC Alloy to deliver to 沙尼. This guide outlines the steps to efficiently complete this mission.

步骤一: Accept the "Clearer Skies" 任务

  • Access your 任务s tab and find "Clearer Skies".
  • Review the objectives: Destroy 3 ARC enemies and Get 3 ARC Alloy for 沙尼.
  • Take on the 任务 to begin.

步骤二: Find and Destroy ARC Enemies

ARC enemies, usually drones for this 任务, can be found throughout the 地图. You can actively look for them or wait for them to appear at certain points.

  • Identify an ARC drone in the environment.
  • Use a reliable weapon to shoot down the drone. Focus fire to destroy it quickly.
  • Confirm the drone has been destroyed.

步骤三: Collect ARC Alloy

Once an ARC enemy is destroyed, you must 搜刮 its remains to collect the required ARC Alloy.

  • Walk toward the downed ARC enemy and 互动 to search it.
  • Find the "ARC Powercell" (or ARC Alloy) item in the 搜刮 container.
  • Transfer at least one ARC Alloy into your 安全口袋. Repeat this step until you have 3 ARC Alloy in total.

步骤四: Use 撤离 Elevators for Additional Enemies

A reliable method to come across ARC drones is by activating an 撤离 elevator, which almost always attracts a drone to your location.

  • Find an 撤离 elevator on the 地图.
  • Activate the elevator to initiate the 撤离 sequence.
  • An ARC drone will likely spawn and engage you near the elevator.
  • Destroy this drone and 搜刮 it for additional ARC Alloy if needed.

步骤五: 撤离 and complete the mission

After you get successfully collected 3 ARC Alloy, you must 撤离 and head back to 沙尼 to finish the mission.

  • Use an 撤离 elevator to head back to your base.
  • Hand over the collected ARC Alloy to 沙尼 to finalize the "Clearer Skies" 任务.
  • Claim your rewards after successful completion.

title: 通讯据点
content:
In this guide, we explain the 'Communication Hideout' 任务. you must find a missing battery cell, install it into a generator, power up the generator, and finally boost an antenna terminal.

步骤一: Find and Retrieve the Battery Cell

Begin your 任务 in Old Town, near the Red Tower. The Communication Hideout objective is highlighted on your 地图.

  • Travel to the specified location on your 地图, around here of Old Town near the Red Tower.
  • Look around for a small, dilapidated structure nestled in the sandy area near a wall.
  • Walk to the container located next to this structure.
  • Use the container to retrieve the missing battery cell.

步骤二: Power the Generator

After you get the battery cell, your next objective is to install it into the nearby generator and power it on.

  • Find the generator, which is a truck-like object with a blinking red light, situated on the cobblestone path near where you found the battery.
  • Walk up to the generator and use it to install the battery cell.
  • After installing the battery, use the generator again to turn on the power.

步骤三: Activate the Antenna Terminal

With power restored, your final task is to arrive at the antenna terminal on the Red Tower and boost it.

  • Walk over to the building next to the generator. you need to enter it until you reach the upper levels.
  • Search nearby for an open window at ground level and climb through it.
  • After entering, navigate through the building and climb the stairs to climb.
  • Reach the rooftop area and find a ladder.
  • Climb the ladder until you reach the higher section of the rooftop.
  • Move around the corner up on the roof until you find the external antenna terminal.
  • Use the terminal to boost it, completing the 'Communication Hideout' 任务.

Once in the 大坝战场 zone, find the 野外补给站. A reliable location for a 野外补给站 is near the 'Electrical Substation' and 'Water Towers' area. You'll be looking for a building with a satellite dish on top.

Place a 路标 to this location and head there.

步骤二: Navigate to the 野外补给站

As you walk toward the specified location, there is a building with a large satellite dish on top, indicating it is a 野外补给站.

The entrance to the depot is at ground level. Go inside the building.

Within the 野外补给站, you'll discover a delivery terminal. This is where you will deliver the 野外箱. The most challenging part of this 任务 is locating the 野外箱 itself, as its spawn location is randomized each time within the vicinity of the 野外补给站.

The 'Eyes in the Sky' 任务 asks you to install three Lidar scanners across different areas of the 地图: 地下城, 大坝战场, and 太空港. This guide goes over each location and the process of placing the scanner.

步骤一: 地下城 Galleria Lidar Scanner

This is the first location for installing a Lidar scanner. Note you must bring a zipline. You can 制作 or buy these, or get lucky on a free 装备方案

  • Look at your 地图 and find the Galleria building in 地下城. It's marked as a commercial building.

步骤二: 大坝战场 Control Tower Lidar Scanner

The second scanner needs to be installed at the Control Tower in 大坝战场.

  • Access your 地图 and find the Control Tower location in 大坝战场.
  • Head over to the Control Tower. you must use the elevator shaft to head over to the top, being mindful of any turrets.
  • Once up on the roof, clear any enemy resistance, featuring the 'bullies' (heavy enemies).
  • Continue to the corner of the rooftop where you'll discover the placement spot for the scanner.
  • Install the Lidar scanner.

步骤三: 太空港 Communications Tower Lidar Scanner

The final scanner is at the Communications Tower in 太空港.

  • Check your 地图 and spot the Communications Tower within the 太空港 area, located on the far east side.
  • Reach the base of the tower and begin your ascent.
  • Climb the ladders to arrive at the top platform of the Communications Tower. [SCREENSHOT:01:08]

While Wolfpack grenades are a fast way to kill 跳跃者, they require 搜刮. This tutorial offers an alternative strategy utilizing a specific choke point in the 太空港 area, allowing for consistent 跳跃者 kills with less reliance on certain gear, and aiding in mission completion.

步骤一: Go to the South Trench Tower

  • Go to the 太空港 area on the 地图.
  • Find the South Trench Tower, which sits close to the 'The Trench' landmark. This tower has multiple broken windows that serve as entry and choke points.

步骤二: Access the Tower via Zipline

  • The most efficient way to get into the tower is by using a zipline.
  • Go toward the tower from the lower ground and look for an active zipline leading up to one of the broken windows.
  • Use the zipline to quickly climb and enter the tower through a broken window. This entry method provides an early warning system and positions you strategically.

步骤三: Set Up Your Choke Point

  • After entering, position yourself facing the broken window where you entered. This window will act as your primary choke point.
  • Optional: Place mines near the zipline entry point up on the roof. This prevents other players from easily flanking you if they attempt to use the same zipline.
  • The 跳跃者的 only other way to reach you in this spot is via a key, making it a highly defensible position against both AI and potentially other players.

步骤四: Engage the 跳跃者

  • The 跳跃者 will eventually walk toward the tower and attempt to enter through the broken window.
  • As it tries to squeeze through the opening, it will become an easy target. Focus your fire on its visible weak spots.
  • Maintain your position, using the wall as cover if needed, and continue to shoot until the 跳跃者 is destroyed.

步骤五: Collect 跳跃者 Parts & Complete 任务s

  • When you've successfully destroying the 跳跃者, collect its remains.
  • You will often find useful 跳跃者 Parts, which are essential for various 任务s in Arc 突袭者.

content:
Straight Record 任务 Guide

Here we explain completing the "Straight Record" 任务 in the 大坝战场 zone. Your objective is to find and shut down an old EMP trap by 互动ing with three specific power switches in a specific order, and then finally disabling the main EMP pole.

步骤一: Walk to the 任务 Area

  • First, heading north in the 大坝战场 zone, towards the area known as Victory Ridge.
  • The certain location for the 任务 will be marked on your 地图.

步骤二: Initiate the 任务

  • After you arrive at Victory Ridge, look for a tall EMP pole next to a large generator. It will have a distinctive yellow mission glow.
  • This is your starting point for the 任务. Activate the EMP pole to begin.
  • You need to find and turn off three generator-type boxes. It's crucial to do them in a specific order, as 互动ing with the wrong box first will prevent further progress.

步骤三: Disable the First Power Switch

  • From the initial EMP pole, head directly north, up onto the ridge.
  • You'll see a power cable stretching out, leading to the first generator box.
  • Follow this cable and use the box to turn it off.

步骤四: Disable the Second Power Switch

  • Turn back around towards the main EMP pole.
  • Look to your left for a half-broken cement house.
  • Climb up to the second floor of this house.
  • From the second floor, look south, and you'll notice the second generator box at the end of what used to be a hallway. use it to turn off the switch.

步骤五: Disable the Third Power Switch

  • From the second generator's location, head south of the main EMP pole again.
  • Try to spot another telephone pole-like structure with a long black power cable hanging from it.
  • Follow this cable to arrive at the third and final generator box. use it to shut off the last switch.

步骤六: Shut Down the EMP Trap

  • Once all three power switches have been turned off, go back to the original EMP pole where you started the 任务.
  • Use the main EMP pole to disable the trap and complete the "Straight Record" 任务.

title: 远日点武器解析
content:
概述

The Aphelion is a recently added Legendary Battle Rifle in ARC 突袭者, known for its unique 'high velocity energy rounds'. At first perceived as underwhelming by some players, this weapon offers impressive stopping power, especially against ARC enemies, and can be very strong in PvP when used correctly. This guide goes over all the key details about the Aphelion, from its stats and best attachments to its strengths and weaknesses in different combat scenarios, and how to 制作 it.

Aphelion 概述 & Acquisition

  • The Aphelion is a Legendary Battle Rifle firing high-velocity energy rounds.
  • It was at first an ultra-rare drop, but its blueprint drop rates have been much increased.
  • You get the Aphelion blueprint by collecting the core of the 女族长 when you defeat her.

Weapon Mechanics & Stats

  • The Aphelion fires in a 2-round burst mode.
  • It has a magazine size of 10 shots, meaning 5 bursts per magazine.
  • When firing, it consumes 2 ammo per 'click' (one burst).
  • Reloading the weapon consumes a single Energy Clip and fully recharges the magazine.
  • The weapon features 'Strong' ARC Armor Penetration and a special 'Experimental' trait.
  • It has high stopping power due to its high-velocity rounds, causing enemies to flinch and even flip.

Optimal Attachments

  • The Aphelion has noticeable recoil, mainly vertical. The first shot lands where aimed, while the second shot tends to go slightly up and to the left.
  • **Vertical Grip:** To mitigate the vertical recoil, a Vertical Grip is highly recommended. For instance, a Vertical Grip III much reduces vertical recoil by 44%.
  • **Stable Stock:** A Stable Stock (e.g., Stable Stock II) helps improve dispersion and recoil recovery time, allowing for quicker follow-up shots.
  • It is worth investing in attachments to improve the weapon's accuracy and control.

PvP Effectiveness & Playstyle

  • The Aphelion is very effective in PvP, especially at mid-range.
  • **Close Range:** Avoid direct close-range engagements as it can lead to issues due to the burst fire and recoil.
  • **Long Range:** It can be effective at long range if you crouch to reduce recoil further.
  • **Mid-Range Sweet Spot:** This is where the Aphelion truly shines. Play around cover, peeking to get your two-round burst off, then retreating to let the recoil reset.
  • **Time to Kill (Body Shots):**
  • **Light Shield:** 3 clicks (6 hits total).
  • **Medium Shield:** 3 clicks (6 hits total).
  • **Heavy Shield:** 4 clicks (8 hits total). Heavy shields offer significant resistance.
  • Playing around the burst delay, similar to using a shotgun like the Anvil, allows for effective peek-shooting tactics.
  • Combining the Aphelion with a close-range weapon (e.g., Venator, Vulcano, Stitcher) can compensate for its close-quarters combat weaknesses.

PvE Effectiveness (ARC Weaknesses & Strengths)

  • **Highs (Strengths):**
  • **Armor Stripping:** The Aphelion is excellent at stripping armor from ARC enemies, specificly flying types and certain components of larger ground units.
  • **Stopping Power:** Its high-velocity rounds cause flying enemies (大黄蜂, 黄蜂, 告密者es) to flinch and flip, interrupting their attacks and leaving them exposed.
  • **火箭兵:** It's considered one of the best weapons for dealing with 火箭兵 due to its ability to disrupt their rocket fire.
  • **Turbines:** Effectively strips armor from Turbines, allowing for follow-up damage with other weapon types. Can also directly target their core.
  • **跳跃者:** Can break apart 跳跃者 legs and dismantle their core eye, rendering them non-functional.
  • **Lows (Weaknesses):**
  • **Raw Damage:** While excellent at stripping armor, the Aphelion lacks raw damage to quickly finish off stripped enemies compared to other energy weapons. Often requires switching to a different weapon for the killing blow.
  • **堡垒 & 轰炸者:** These are the toughest targets. Breaking their joints or batteries takes too much effort with the Aphelion; a different caliber weapon is recommended for these targets once armor is stripped.
  • For general ARC killing, the Aphelion is best used in combination with a different gun that can finish enemies once their armor has been stripped and they are stunned.

制作 the Aphelion

  • To 制作 the Aphelion, you first need to get its blueprint from the 女族长的 core.
  • You will also need Gunsmith Level 3.
  • The required resources are:
  • 3x Magnetic Accelerator
  • 3x Complex Gun Parts
  • 1x 女族长 Reactor
  • Acquiring the 女族长 Reactor is right now the most challenging part of 制作 this weapon due to its rarity.

title: ARC生存指南
content:
概述

The PVE threats in ARC 突袭者 are many and can be deadly if you're unprepared. This guide goes over the best ways to take on each type of ARC enemy, centered on both easy and resource-efficient methods. We'll cover 大黄蜂, 跳跃者, 火箭兵, ARC 勘测兵, and 轰炸者, excluding the 女王 as she deserves her own dedicated guide.

步骤一: 大黄蜂

  • Threat Level: High
  • Armor Plate: Semi Plated
  • Primary Attack: Electric shock
  • Special Abilities: Stuns
  • Weakness: Rear thrusters
  • Health: 200

Killing a 大黄蜂 is like taking down a wasp: aim for the rotors. The front two rotors are armor-plated, so heavy ammo weapons will be more effective against them. If using light ammo, focus on the rear two rotors, though this can be tricky due to the angle.

Dodge Attacks:

  • Wait for the three yellow targeting lasers to combine into one.
  • They will flash red just before firing, which is your cue to perform a dodge roll.
  • Timing is key; spamming dodge roll is ineffective as they compensate.
  • A little distance can help, as closer attacks are harder to dodge.

步骤二: 跳跃者

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Leaps on you
  • Special Abilities: Releases kinetic energy
  • Weakness: Joints and its eye
  • Health: 1500

跳跃者 are exposed to tight spaces and fire. Blaze Grenades and 火球 Burners are viable choices.

Method 1: Grenades and Positioning

  • Bring about three Blaze Grenades or 火球 Burners.
  • Position yourself in buildings or bunkers where 跳跃者 struggle to get through small doorways or reach you when indoors. For example, using bunkers on the 太空港 is always advised.

  • Aim to land grenades on the center eye-piece of the 跳跃者 to spread fire to all three limbs.

Method 2 (Preferred): Blaze Grenade Trap & Jolt Mine

  • This method is easier and more resource-efficient.
  • A single Blaze Grenade Trap will shred a 跳跃者的 armor.

  • Place a Blaze Grenade Trap, shoot the 跳跃者 until it launches itself into the air, then take a few steps back.
  • Optionally, combine with a Jolt Mine for extra insurance to stun and keep the 跳跃者 in the fire.

  • You can recycle 跳跃者 Pulse Units for Advanced Mechanical Components as they're not often useful.

步骤三: 火箭兵

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Missile Barrage
  • Weakness: Thrusters (covered in armor plating)
  • Health: 1100

火箭兵 can be terrifying, but easy to defeat with the right strategy.

Recommended Weapon: Anvil

  • Anvil (Hand Cannon) is an easy-to-get heavy ammo weapon with a quick fire rate.

  • Approximately 40 rounds of heavy ammo should suffice.
  • Consider upgrading your Anvil to increase its fire rate.

Strategy: Distance and Thruster Focus

  • Before engaging, make sure you have ample cover, preferably inside a building or close to an entrance.

  • Start your attack from as far away as possible.
  • Aim for a single thruster. Taking out two thrusters will send the 火箭兵 plummeting to the ground, often killing it outright if high enough.

  • 火箭兵 are slow for a flying ARC, allowing you to kill them before they close distance.
  • Wolfpacks are really good but generally better saved for 女王 fights.

步骤四: ARC 勘测兵

  • Threat Level: Low
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Charges at 突袭者 when provoked
  • Weakness: Exposes its core when transmitting
  • Health: Unknown

勘测兵 are frustrating to chase. This method ensures a solo kill every time.

Recommended Items: Showstopper & Trigger 'Nades

  • You'll need one Showstopper grenade (搜刮ed, not 制作ed) and three Trigger 'Nades (制作able).

Strategy: Stun and Detonate

  • Sneak close enough to land a Showstopper grenade as your opening attack.

  • As soon as the 勘测兵 is stunned, switch to Trigger 'Nades and lay them on thick. Use all grenades while it's stunned.
  • Detonate all three Trigger 'Nades. This should be more thenough to destroy it.
  • If no Showstoppers are available, you might still land a couple of Trigger 'Nades before it flees, then finish it off with shots.
  • Bring a heavy ammo weapon like the Anvil for best impact if going without Showstoppers.

  • 搜刮 any pieces that fall off the 勘测兵, as they may contain useful ARC Notion Cores.

步骤五: 堡垒

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Projectile
  • Weakness: Back panel, joints
  • Health: ~2000

The easiest method for 堡垒 requires teamwork.

Method 1 (Preferred - Team): Torrente & Ammo

  • You'll need a friend (or someone you can tolerate), a Torrente LMG, and a lot of medium ammo.

  • Setup: You and your partner should be on either side of the 堡垒, with ample cover, preferably on raised ground.

  • Execution: Your friend fires the first shot to bait the 堡垒的 attention. Then, crouch to increase accuracy and aim for the small yellow canister on the rear armor plating.
  • Empty your magazine into its back while it's turned. This spot is unarmored.

  • Step back, reload, and wait for your friend to pull its attention again, then repeat.
  • You should kill it within three reloads of a Torrente.

Method 2 (Solo): Explosives

  • If solo, bring five or six Trigger 'Nades, Snap Blasts, or Heavy Fuse grenades.
  • Stick them to the 堡垒 itself each time its aim resets.

  • Trying to take down a 堡垒 solo with basic weaponry by shooting its knee joints is very risky and time-consuming, likely drawing hostile 突袭者. Investing in explosives is better.

步骤六: 轰炸者

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: None
  • Primary Attack: Mortar Round
  • Special Abilities: Releases Kinetic Energy
  • Weakness: Back panel, joints
  • Health: Unknown

The 轰炸者 is lethal, with no armor plating on its main body, but its mortar fire is destructive.

Method 1 (Preferred - Solo): Trigger 'Nades & Shelter

  • You'll need five or six Trigger 'Nades.
  • Find a position to start throwing these grenades from while having a roof over your head. This makes it harder for the 轰炸者 to land shots.
  • Stick as many grenades as possible before it starts opening fire on you.

  • You can ignore the 勘测者 drones if you have overhead shelter.
  • Optionally, bring a Showstopper grenade to lock them in place for easier hits with Trigger 'Nades.

  • Investing in explosives is highly recommended for a quick solo kill.

Method 2 (Team): Distraction & Damage

  • Similar to the 堡垒 strategy, you need a friend willing to take its attention.
  • While your friend distracts, focus your damage on the unarmored rear canister.
  • Both players will need a sheltered building on either side of the 轰炸者 to make this work, which can be very certain and awkward to pull off.

title: ARC弱点
content:
概述

Understanding the unique weaknesses of each ARC enemy type can a lot improve your combat effectiveness. Here we go over specific strategies and preferred gadgets for neutralizing 跳跃者, 火箭兵, Bombadiers, 堡垒, 黄蜂, and 大黄蜂.

步骤一: 跳跃者 - Fire Weakness

跳跃者 are highly susceptible to fire damage, which can quickly disable them.

  • When run intoing a 跳跃者, prepare to use fire-based consumables.
  • Select either a Blaze Grenade or a Blaze Rod from your 背包.
  • Throw the fire explosive at the 跳跃者. The fire will cause significant damage and often make the 跳跃者 fall to the ground.
  • If it stands in the fire too long, it will be temporarily disabled and eventually destroyed.

Recommended: Blaze Grenades or Blaze Rods are very effective against 跳跃者.

步骤二: 火箭兵 - Stun & Target or Heavy Weapons

火箭兵 can be tricky due to their aerial mobility, but they have distinct vulnerabilities.

  • When a 火箭兵 appears, prepare a stunning explosive like a 大黄蜂 Driver or Showstopper Grenade.
  • Throw the stunning explosive at the 火箭兵 to bring it down to the ground.
  • Once stunned, you have a 10-second window to get on top of the 火箭兵 and shoot its thrusters for maximum damage.
  • Alternatively, for a quick and quiet takedown, use high-damage weapons like the Wolfpack or a Holecracker shot.

Recommended: 大黄蜂 Driver, Showstopper Grenade (for stun) or Wolfpack, Ferro Shots to the rotors (for direct damage).

步骤三: Bombadier & 堡垒 - Sticky Explosives or Knee Disabling

Both Bombadiers and 堡垒 share similar weaknesses, specificly to sticky explosives and specific tactical targeting.

  • Aim for the weak spot on their back. If you can get close enough without being aggroed, sticky grenades are ideal.
  • Use Snap Blast Grenades or Trigger Nades, which adhere to the enemy and deal explosive damage.
  • Another strategy involves damaging their knees. Continuously shoot their knees until they explode. This will temporarily disable them.
  • During the disabled state, unleash as much damage as possible with your weapons. They will not attack you during this brief window.
  • In scenarios with multiple ARC types, use Lure Grenades to make Bombadiers or 堡垒 fire their missiles at other ARC enemies, well making them fight each other.

Recommended: Snap Blast Grenades, Trigger Nades, and Lure Grenades.

步骤四: 黄蜂 - Direct Body Shots

黄蜂, while less threatening, can be aggressive and annoying. A direct move toward is often best.

  • If you spot a 黄蜂 in the air and it's about to aggro on you, aim for its main body.
  • Shooting its main body is the most effective way to take it down quickly (e.g., three Anvil shots are usually enough).
  • Avoid shooting its thrusters, as this will destabilize it and make it fly around unpredictably, making it harder to hit while it continues to attack.

步骤五: 大黄蜂 - Front Plating Exploitation

大黄蜂 can be taken down efficiently by centered on their armor plating.

  • When engaging a 大黄蜂, instead of trying to hit the smaller back thrusters, focus on shooting the front plating.
  • After the front plating is shot down, it will expose the thruster directly behind it. Continue to fire through this opening.
  • This method allows you to hit two thrusters on one side with sustained fire, bringing the 大黄蜂 down much faster.

There are many effective ways to deal with ARC enemies, utilizing both your weapons and various gadgets available in the game. Experiment with different strategies, featuring the use of Horned Drivers or 黄蜂 Drivers, to find what works best for you in different combat scenarios.

These specialized tools, whether 制作ed or found, can be powerful against ARCs, offering creative solutions beyond standard weapon fire.

title: 蓝门谜题与战利品
content:
概述

In this guide, we cover all the puzzles in the 蓝门 area, covering both surface and tunnel locations. Each puzzle requires certain actions, like inserting batteries or pressing buttons in a sequence, to unlock useful 搜刮. Pay close attention to 地图 markers and environmental clues to find these elusive objectives.

步骤一: Ancient Fort Puzzles

The first set of puzzles sits at the Ancient Fort. you need to find and insert three batteries into power stations to activate the 搜刮. The batteries usually spawn on crates around the ruins.

  • Find the Ancient Fort on your 地图.
  • Start at the bottom-left corner of the fort ruins.
  • Pick up the first battery, usually found on crates.
  • Walk over to the first power station, following the black wires if needed.
  • Place the battery inside the power station.
  • Move to the second ruin building. [SCREENSHOT:01:45]
  • Find the second battery on a crate within these ruins.
  • Navigate to the second power station located along the wall, following the black wire.
  • Insert the second battery.
  • Go to the third power station, usually in the top floor. [SCREENSHOT:03:07]
  • Find the third battery, often in a dark room on a crate.
  • Insert the third battery into the power station.
  • Once all three batteries are inserted, the lights will turn green, indicating the 搜刮 is accessible in the basement.
  • Go down into the basement to collect your 搜刮, usually found on a table or shelf.

步骤二: 突袭者's Refuge Puzzles

This location is known as a 'hot drop' due to high player traffic. Exercise caution. you must press four hidden buttons to unlock the basement 搜刮.

  • Find 突袭者's Refuge on your 地图, near 'The Forest' region.
  • Find the first button on your left of the basement entrance, next to an AC unit.
  • Press the button to activate the first light. [SCREENSHOT:04:27]
  • Find the second button, often behind some wooden planks or debris to the right of the basement entrance.
  • Press the second button. [SCREENSHOT:04:52]
  • Head inside the main building structure and climb the ladder.
  • Find the third button on your left when you reach the top.
  • Press the third button.
  • The fourth button sits on the opposite side of the building's roof, near the communication tower. [SCREENSHOT:06:00]
  • Press the fourth button. [SCREENSHOT:06:12]
  • With all four buttons pressed, the lights at the basement entrance will turn green.
  • Go down into the basement (Secret Cellar) to collect your high-value 搜刮.

步骤三: MANTIKOR (ARC Husk) Puzzles

There are two MANTIKOR locations on the 地图, both with similar puzzles involving power cells. This guide shows one version. you must find and install two power cells into the massive ARC husk.

  • Find the MANTIKOR husk on your 地图, near 'Checkpoint'.
  • Find power cells scattered around the dead ARC husk, usually on the ground.
  • Collect at least two power cells. [SCREENSHOT:07:00]
  • Climb up the side of the husk to the interior.
  • Find the first power cell slot and 互动 to insert a cell. This will trigger fire and loud noises, alerting other players.
  • Jump or climb to the opposite side to find the second power cell slot.
  • Insert the second power cell. [SCREENSHOT:07:38]
  • This completes the puzzle, opening a 搜刮 container near the power cell slots.

步骤四: Reinforced Reception Tunnel Puzzles

This puzzle is located within the tunnels, requiring you to follow colored lines and insert batteries. The batteries can sometimes glitch, so be patient.

  • Find the Reinforced Reception area on your 地图.
  • Enter the facility and find the main puzzle console.
  • Use the console; it will show a color (red, blue, or yellow) corresponding to lines on the floor.
  • Follow the indicated colored line to a specific door. [SCREENSHOT:09:00]
  • Find a battery located near the door you followed.

The key to the skill's value is the high-tier, consistent 搜刮 found within the security containers. These are essentially weapon lockers that drastically reduce the need for 制作 high-level gear.

Weekly Trials 概述

Here you'll see how to three-star all weekly trials in just two matches without extensive preparation or specific blueprints. We'll cover throwing snowballs at 火箭兵, damaging flying ARC enemies, opening ARC probes, destroying fireballs (all on 寒潮), and dealing damage to 碎裂者 (on 斯特拉蒙蒂斯 夜间突袭).

步骤一: Throw Snowballs at 火箭兵

For a three-star trial, you need to throw 16 snowballs at a 火箭兵. Snowballs spawn in clumps around most buildings on all 地图s. You can collect one snowball, wait two seconds, and collect another from the exact same spot to stack them efficiently.

  • Collect 20-25 snowballs before engaging if possible.
  • Snowballs will respawn after a short delay, allowing you to pick up multiple from a single spot.

Bringing Down a 火箭兵

火箭兵 are flying enemies, so you need a strategy to ground them:

  • **Less Reliable Method:** Use a Showstopper or 大黄蜂 Driver to stun it and hope it lands on its back. This method relies heavily on luck and timing.
  • **Consistent Method:** Shoot two thrusters on the same side of the 火箭兵. This will disable its flight and bring it to the ground.
  • Focus only on the thrusters. Damaging other parts might destroy it before both thrusters are out, making it fly again.

Once grounded, pelt the 火箭兵 with snowballs until the trial requirement is met. Each snowball deals 1 damage.

步骤二: Damage Flying ARC Enemies

This trial requires damaging flying ARC enemies like 告密者es, 黄蜂, and 大黄蜂.

  • Find high ground, such as the Grandioso apartment buildings, for better visibility and engagement.
  • Shoot 告密者es; they will often spawn waves of 黄蜂 and 大黄蜂, which are flying ARC enemies.
  • You'll come across another 火箭兵 later in the match. Aim to damage its thrusters without killing it if other players are around, so they can also complete their trials.

步骤三: Open ARC Probes

To complete this trial, you must open and 搜刮 three ARC probes.

  • Find smoke plumes rising into the air across the 地图; these indicate crashed ARC probes.
  • When you get close, probes will appear on your mini地图. Regularly pull up your 地图 to spot them as you traverse the area.
  • You can 搜刮 probes that other players have already 破解ed and opened.

步骤四: Destroy 火球

You must destroy six fireballs for this trial.

  • A great location for fireballs on 地下城 (寒潮) is the underground Metro area. In 寒潮 events, the Metro is open, allowing full access.
  • After eliminating fireballs on one side of the Metro, call the train to cross over and find more on the other side.
  • 火球 also spawn in other buildings like the Hospital, Space Travel, Research & Administration, and Galleria.

步骤五: Deal Damage to 碎裂者

  • Two Snapblast grenades or five Impact grenades thrown at the 碎裂者的 bottom can destroy it.

title: 11月10日周试炼高分指南
content:
概述

Here you'll see how to get 3 stars on all weekly trials to earn free rewards and blueprints. We'll cover the best strategies for each trial, featuring best routes, enemy weaknesses, and tips for dealing with other players. Credit to The Gaming Merchant for the tips!

步骤一: Damage 堡垒

For the Damage 堡垒 trial, you need to destroy 堡垒 found at certain locations. Your goal is to reach one of these locations as quickly as possible so that no other players get there before you. The easiest one to use is the Hydroponic Dome Complex.

  • **Find 堡垒 Spawns:** Identify the Hydroponic Dome Complex or Power Generation Complex on the 地图 as potential 堡垒 spawn points.
  • **Rush to Location:** Head directly to one of the 堡垒 spawn points. The Hydroponic Dome Complex is often the easiest due to a cheese strategy.
  • **Use Door Peeking:** Position yourself at one of the Hydroponic Dome doors. Bait the 堡垒 towards the door. It's too large to get its head around the corner, allowing you to peek and shoot its kneecaps safely.
  • **Target Kneecaps:** Focus fire on the yellow kneecaps. Destroying them will temporarily disable the 堡垒.
  • **Damage During Disable:** When the 堡垒 is disabled, freely attack it and use any Snapblast grenades or Triggernades for maximum damage.
  • **背包 Check:** Keep an eye on your ammo and other items in your 背包.
  • **Destroy 堡垒:** Continue this process until the 堡垒 is destroyed.
  • **Player Awareness:** Be cautious of other players attempting to PvP you. Consider bringing barricades to protect your back while engaging the 堡垒.
  • **Repeat at Pipeline Tower:** After destroying the first 堡垒, quickly move to the Pipeline Tower for the second 堡垒.
  • **Optimal Strategy at Pipeline Tower:** Use a similar peeking strategy at the Pipeline Tower entrance, as shown. While not as perfect as Hydroponic, the door still provides significant cover.
  • **Respawn Farming:** 堡垒 will respawn in the same locations periodically. If you destroy the Hydroponic Dome 堡垒 fast enough, it will respawn with the next wave, allowing you to repeat the process for more points.
  • **Efficient 搜刮:** Only spend a short time 搜刮 after destroying a 堡垒. Time is crucial, and other players may be nearby.
  • **Maximize Spawns:** As a solo player, aiming for two 堡垒 destructions will get you three stars. If you want to push further, speed-run the first two and then wait for the next spawn wave to fight one or two more.
  • **Time Management:** Always monitor the final 撤离 time. A good rule of thumb is to allow one minute for every 100 meters you must walk to the 撤离 point.

By following these steps, you can achieve a high score in the Damage 堡垒 trial.

步骤二: Damage 黄蜂

大坝age 黄蜂 trial is an excellent opportunity to accumulate a high score, especially during the 太空港 隐藏地堡 event, which offers 2x points.

  • **Choose 太空港 隐藏地堡:** This event is ideal for 黄蜂 farming due to its bonus points and fewer ground-based ARCs.
  • **Prepare 告密者 Scanners:** Before entering the 突袭, stock up on 告密者 Scanners. Bringing 5 will allow you to kill 10 黄蜂 for a 3-star rating.
  • **Engage 黄蜂 Safely:** Upon arrival, use 告密者 Scanners one by one to aggro 黄蜂. Fight them individually to avoid being overwhelmed.
  • **Use Cover:** Find a safe position, such as inside a building, to peek out and shoot 黄蜂.
  • **Monitor Scanners:** Keep track of your 告密者 Scanners in your 背包.
  • **Launch Tower Strategy:** After using your initial 告密者 Scanners, walk to the Launch Tower. Climb the ladder for an advantageous position.
  • **Elevated Position:** The Launch Tower provides a great vantage point, making it difficult for other players to push you while you farm 黄蜂.
  • **隐藏地堡 Opening:** After the 隐藏地堡 is open, most players will rush there, leaving you with free rein to farm 黄蜂.
  • **Aggro More 黄蜂:** If you run out of 告密者 Scanners, you can shoot nearby passive snitches to aggro 黄蜂 and 大黄蜂 towards you.
  • **黄蜂 Aiming Tip:** 黄蜂 are coded to dodge your aim when you're aiming down sights. Instead, wait for the 黄蜂 to stop moving (usually just before it fires), then aim slightly above its head for a one-shot kill with the Hullcracker.
  • **大黄蜂 Strategy:** The same aiming tip applies to 大黄蜂.
  • **Destroy Entire 黄蜂:** For maximum points, make sure you destroy the 黄蜂 entirely, not just its wings. Three Anvil shots to the body will kill it.

步骤三: Destroy 火球

The best 地图 for destroying 火球 is 大坝战场 at night, specificly the Testing Annex area.

  • **Optimal Location:** Go to the Testing Annex on 大坝战场 (夜间突袭).
  • **火球 Spawns:** This area is rich with 火球 spawns, specificly in the underground sections and buildings.
  • **Optimal Route:** Start at Water Treatment Control, go through the underground to Primary Facility, then Control Tower, and finally Research & Administration. There are many 火球 in these areas.
  • **Shooting 火球:** Focus on shooting the 火球 as they appear. They often come in groups.
  • **Efficient Pathing:** Continue moving through the designated route, destroying 火球 as they spawn. After you've cleared the 火球 in one area, move to the next.
  • **Keep Moving:** If no more 火球 are spawning in your current location, continue to Power Generation Complex or other marked areas, always keeping an eye on the final 撤离.

步骤四: Download Data during 隐藏地堡

This trial requires you to download data from PCs within the 隐藏地堡, usually on the 太空港 地图.

  • **Access 隐藏地堡:** Wait for the 隐藏地堡 event to be available. Activate the satellites to open the bunker entrance.
  • **Find PCs:** After entering, find the PCs in the 隐藏地堡. There are generally eight PCs available for data download.
  • **Initiate Download:** 互动 with a PC to start the data download. You must stay close to the PC for the download to continue.
  • **Wait for Completion:** Stay near the PC until the download is complete. This process takes some time.
  • **Repeat for All PCs:** Download data from all eight PCs to maximize your score (up to 6,400 points).
  • **Cooldown Period:** If another player has recently downloaded from a PC, it will be on a short cooldown (1-2 minutes) before you can access it.
  • **Solo vs. Squad:** Doing this solo can be boring but is an easy way to get points. In solos, other players are often friendly and will share PCs.

步骤五: Deliver Carriables

For the Deliver Carriables mission, the most efficient way to collect and deliver carriables is by utilizing 野外补给站s.

  • **野外补给站 Locations:** 野外补给站s are available on 大坝战场, 地下城, and 太空港.
  • **Collect Carriables:** Find and collect carriables (e.g., batteries, data drives). You can often find multiple carriables around 野外补给站s.
  • **Deliver to Depot:** Drop your collected carriables into the 野外补给站s. You can deposit more than one carriable in each depot.
  • **Maximize Deliveries:** Aim to deliver four batteries in a 夜间突袭 to achieve the full three stars for this trial.
summary: 本教程提供专家策略和理想路线，以在所有周试炼中获得3星评级，重点介绍堡垒、黄蜂、火球和数据下载的最大化得分。

title: 第五周试炼
content:
概述: Maximize Your Trial Points

For all trial challenges, aim to finish them during major 地图 conditions like 夜间突袭s, 电磁风暴s, or the 隐藏地堡 event, which offer a 2x bonus on your UI. Always load into a fresh 地图 to maximize your time, keeping an eye on the timer at the highest point of your screen. If you're in at the 30-40 minute mark, you'll maximize points. Staying in the round until the last minutes and 撤离ing after most players have left can often be safer when playing solo. Remember, you must successfully 撤离 to retain any points earned.

Trial 1: Damage 火箭兵

This challenge pushes both solo players and teams to deal as much damage as possible to 火箭兵 in a single 突袭. Full points are awarded if you or your team are the sole ones damaging a 火箭兵 until it's brought down. Consider using a combination of Wolfpacks, Hullcrackers, Jupiters, and Heavy Ammo based weapons for maximum efficiency.

  • A full kill of a 火箭兵 is worth about 2600 points. You'll need two kills to hit the three-star threshold.
  • Farming Location 1: 太空港 Launch Tower
  • Anchor yourself midway up on the 太空港 Launch Tower during any major 地图 condition, ideally the 隐藏地堡 for extra farming time. From here, set up mines on entry points and use great sightlines to pull every 火箭兵 on the 地图 towards you. Be aware, this is a high-traffic area, so players may attempt to engage in PvP.
  • Farming Location 2: 蓝门 Pilgrim's Peak Tower
  • Another excellent location is the tower at Pilgrim's Peak on 蓝门. Bring a sniper and Wolfpacks to easily pull every 火箭兵 on the 地图. This location also features a double 火箭兵 spawn, meaning two quick kills with less resistance.
  • Targeting 火箭兵: Aim for the armor paneling over its central eye with heavy or energy ammo weapons. Breaking this panel exposes its crit spot, allowing for quick takedowns with regular gunfire.

步骤二: Download Data During 隐藏地堡

This trial requires downloading data from terminals inside the 隐藏地堡. We strongly recommend doing this solo due to the nature of the lobbies, but it takes a significant amount of time to complete.

  • There are only 8 terminals inside the 隐藏地堡, each awarding 800 points per download. You need five terminals to arrive at the three-star ranking.
  • Activating the Bunker: When you load into the 隐藏地堡 地图, four antennas need to be activated before the bunker opens. These antennas are randomly placed at the start of the 地图.
  • Entering the Bunker: Once all antennas are active, go to the bunker entrance.
  • Downloading Data: Inside, find the eight computer terminals. Activate a terminal to begin downloading data. A yellow light will flash, and a green progress bar will appear. After the bar completes, the light turns green, and data can be collected.
  • Strategic Data Collection: Pay attention to which consoles are near completion and grab the data if you can. Move on to the next activated console rather than activating a new one yourself if other players are present, as you'll be stuck there during the download. Be cautious, as players can get impatient and attempt to use grenades.
  • If you download all eight terminals and successfully 撤离, you'll secure 6400 points.

步骤三: Search First Wave Husks

Searching First Wave Husks is a straightforward challenge with high point farming potential. Each husk awards around 800 points.

  • Find dead ARC bodies (Rocketter husks, Baron husks, 大黄蜂 husks) that you can 破解 and 搜刮 throughout the environment. You can either be the one to 破解 them or just 互动 with ones already 破解ed by other players.
  • Optimal Location: 太空港
  • 太空港 is probably the best option due to the high number of husks that spawn on the outskirts of the 地图, away from typical danger zones. These areas rarely see PvP action.
  • This challenge is free 装备方案 friendly, but bringing adrenaline shots is recommended to manage running across the 地图 more efficiently.

步骤四: Damage 告密者es

Damaging 告密者es offers huge point farming potential because they respawn quickly once killed.

  • Each 告密者 awards 600 points, so you only need seven to achieve your three-star ranking for the week.
  • Elevated Strategy: Get yourself or your team to an elevated, centralized location on the 地图. Use a sniper or Jupiter to pull every 告密者 to you.
  • 地图 Conditions: 隐藏地堡 offers extra time, making it a prime location. 夜间突袭 and any other 2x condition on any 地图 will also work. The key is elevation, the ability to defend that elevation from other teams, and suitable gear to quickly pull and take down ARC enemies.

步骤五: Damage Ground-Based ARC Enemies

While this challenge has high point farming potential, it's often the hardest to achieve a high score due to contested enemies. You'll only receive 80% of the total 经验值 gained on kills as points, meaning smaller enemies like Picks, 爆弹, and 火球 yield very few points.

  • Focus on Larger Enemies: Target larger enemies such as 堡垒, 轰炸者, and 跳跃者, as these are ideal for farming points.
  • Optimal Location: 隐藏地堡
  • 隐藏地堡 remains the best place to wrap up this challenge. 跳跃者, 堡垒, and 轰炸者 will spawn above the 隐藏地堡 in a centralized location, and you'll have an extra 10 minutes to farm. Be aware, this will be a PvP hot zone.
  • Alternative Location: 大坝战场 (电磁风暴)
  • 大坝战场 during an 电磁风暴 is another ideal 地图. It features two 堡垒 spawns, a 轰炸者 spawn, and three to five 跳跃者 spawns. This gives solo players more options to avoid PvP, and groups can split up to maximize farming efforts.

title: 第六周试炼高分指南
content:
概述: Weekly Trials & General Tips

This week's trials offer great potential for high scores, with the possibility of reaching 150,000 to 200,000 points. The guide will detail strategies for solo completion to achieve three stars, identifying the best point-farming opportunities, and suggesting free 装备方案-friendly options.

  • Major 地图 Conditions for Full Points: Only certain conditions yield full points: 隐藏地堡, 夜间突袭s, and 电磁风暴s. Minor conditions like Harvesters or 女族长 only grant half points.
  • Optimal Playstyle: For achieving three stars, playing solo is often easier due to fewer player 互动ions. Though, for maximum leaderboard points, playing in a group of three is recommended. [SCREENSHOT:01:15]
  • 隐藏地堡 地图: While less reliant this week, the 隐藏地堡 condition still offers the best environment for several trials.

步骤一: Damage 大黄蜂

  • Points: 365 points per thruster kill, 760 points per main body kill. High farm potential, but not ideal for free 装备方案s.
  • Recommended Farm Location: 太空港, in specific the Trench Towers (South or North).
  • Strategy:
  • Drop into a 隐藏地堡 地图 condition.
  • Use Adrenaline Shots to quickly reach one of the Trench Towers.
  • Zipline onto the tower.
  • Deploy Barricades and Traps around your position.
  • Make sure weapons are well-repaired and bring plenty of ammo.
  • This high ground position offers excellent safety from other players and consistent 大黄蜂 spawns.
  • Respawn Optimization: Kill all wasps and hornets in a patrol to encourage faster respawns of new patrols. If only hornets are killed, wasps remaining might delay new spawns.
  • Maximize Points: Aim for the main body of the 大黄蜂 (760 points) instead of just the thrusters (365 points) for higher scores.
  • By following this method, players can realistically achieve upwards of 48,000 points in this trial.

步骤二: Deliver Carriables



  • Points: 1000 points per carriable delivered. Bad farm potential, but great for free 装备方案s.
  • Recommended 地图s: 太空港 or 大坝战场 for the highest potential 野外箱 spawns.
  • Strategy:
  • Use an online 互动ive 地图 to track potential 野外箱 spawns.
  • Expect around 10 野外箱s per game at best.
  • Be aware of other players also doing this challenge, as they can clear spawns. [SCREENSHOT:05:35]
  • For a solo three-star completion, it's manageable, but for leaderboard farming, it requires many attempts and good RNG due to competition.
  • Focus on getting the three stars and don't over-invest if other players are active.

步骤三: Damage 火箭兵, 跳跃者 or 堡垒


  • Points: Approximately 2,200 points per kill (tested on leapers & rocketeers). Great farm potential, but bad for free 装备方案s.
  • Recommended Location: 太空港, in certain the bottom of the Launch Towers.
  • Strategy:
  • This is an aggressive position, so be prepared for PvP run intos.
  • From the Launch Tower, you can spot 2-3 跳跃者 spawns, 3 火箭兵 spawns, and even a 堡垒 spawn.
  • 隐藏地堡 Alternative: The 隐藏地堡 地图 also works for extra time, but beware of 轰炸者 in the same areas as 堡垒, which can be problematic.

步骤四: Destroy 爆弹


  • Points: 880 points per kill. Great farm potential, great for free 装备方案s (just needs 搜刮 ammo).
  • Recommended Location: 斯特拉蒙蒂斯, certainly during a 夜间突袭 地图 condition.
  • Strategy:
  • Queue for 斯特拉蒙蒂斯 - 夜间突袭 when it's nearing its final minutes or seconds. This can lead to a game that won't respawn new players, creating a quieter lobby for solo farming.
  • Remain quiet in the initial minutes to allow other players to fight or 撤离, shrinking the lobby.
  • After the lobby is smaller, rotate between the two sandbox areas, control areas, and the Metro Station 撤离 point, as 爆弹 respawn quickly in these areas.
  • Alternative: If 斯特拉蒙蒂斯 isn't ideal, 地下城 is your second-best option. Focus on Research, Space Travel, Parking Garage, Hospital, and 撤离 points.

步骤五: Open ARC Probes


  • Points: 1,334 points per search. Extremely free 装备方案 friendly, great farm potential.
  • Recommended 地图: 大坝战场 on an 电磁风暴. [SCREENSHOT:09:59]
  • Strategy:
  • Bring a lot of Adrenaline Shots to quickly cover the 地图.
  • In 电磁风暴s, probes often spawn in packs of two or three. [SCREENSHOT:10:07]
  • You don't need an 互动ive 地图; just pay attention to the dark smoke coming from 破解ed ARCs and constantly check your 地图.
  • ARC probes will show up on your 地图 when you zoom in, even if they're far away.
  • Important: It's about 'searching' the probe, not '破解ing' it. If another player has already 破解ed a probe, you can still search it for points.

title: 第七周试炼
content:
概述: Weekly Trials Week 7

This week marks the final week for Trials in Season 1, extending until Tuesday, offering players an extra day to complete objectives. The primary focus for many will be maintaining their current rank, though pushing for higher ranks is still possible. For maximum points, prioritize trials within major 地图 conditions like 夜间突袭s or 电磁风暴s, which grant double points. 女王/女族长 trials, though, should be tackled in their specific minor 地图 conditions (Harvester or 女族长 events).

Destroy 蜱虫, 火球, and 爆弹

  • Each kill grants 470 points.
  • The best 地图 for this challenge is 斯特拉蒙蒂斯, in specific during a 夜间突袭 event.
  • 斯特拉蒙蒂斯 is densely populated with 蜱虫, 爆弹, and 火球.
  • Strategic Queuing: Queue for a 夜间突袭 on 斯特拉蒙蒂斯 when it's nearing its final seconds or minutes. This can lead to an empty lobby with no mid-突袭 player respawns, allowing you to clear ARCs solo without PvP interference.
  • Recommended Locations:
  • The Seed Vault has about 6-8 蜱虫.
  • Archives is rich with 爆弹, 火球, and mini 蜱虫, certainly on the ceiling.
  • The Control Rooms are also excellent spots for 爆弹 and 火球.
  • PvP Avoidance: Avoid high PvP areas like the Lobby, Medical Research, and Loading Bay. If you hear gunshots, change direction. After the lobby starts to clear up, you can extend your search.

Search resource drops

  • Each Supply Pod searched grants 1600 points.
  • This trial is highly RNG-dependent; there isn't one definitive best 地图. 太空港 has historically been consistent, though the video demonstrates a run on 大坝战场.
  • Identifying Supply Stations: Find a glowing white bulb shining on top of the station to indicate it hasn't been used yet.
  • Gaining Points: You only need to 'tap' (搜刮) the supply pod to gain points; you don't need to call it in yourself.
  • Our 互动ive 地图 can show potential spawn locations for them

Damage 黄蜂

  • Each 黄蜂 main body kill grants ~440 points.
  • The ideal location is 隐藏地堡 when it's activated, as it spawns 黄蜂.
  • Alternatively, 太空港 during a 夜间突袭 or 电磁风暴 event is a strong choice, centered on the Launch Tower or Control Tower areas.
  • Strategy with 告密者 Scanners: Hoard multiple 告密者 Scanners, then position yourself on a high vantage point like the top of a tower on 太空港. Deploy traps at entrances and use scanners to detect and eliminate 黄蜂 as they appear. This is highly consistent for points.
  • Strategy without Scanners: Take high ground (e.g., a tower), use traps to protect yourself, and attract 告密者es. 告密者es will call in two extra 黄蜂 per reinforcement, helping you meet the ~10 黄蜂 needed for three stars.

Damage 堡垒

  • Each 堡垒 kill grants ~4510 points.
  • 隐藏地堡, if active, is ideal as it spawns two 堡垒 directly on top, allowing for continuous farming.
  • 太空港 is also an excellent choice, with a solid six potential spawn locations, usually guaranteeing two 堡垒 per game. You can rotate between kills and allowing them to respawn.
  • Easy 3-Star Method: Bring 2-3 Wolfpacks; throwing them at a 堡垒 will instantly kill it, allowing for a quick 撤离.
  • Farming Strategy (太空港): For sustained point farming, either sit on top of Trench Tower and kill the 堡垒 below it or bunker up on Container Storage. Be mindful of PvP, as heavy weapons like the Hullcracker attract attention.
  • If aiming for 3 stars without min-maxing, two 堡垒 kills are enough for over 8,000 points.

Damage 女王 or 女族长

  • Damage dealt translates to points at a 0.7:1 ratio. You need 5715 damage (not 经验值) to head over to the 3-star threshold.
  • This is the most challenging and expensive trial for solo players.
  • Method 1 (High Cost, Low Effort): Use roughly eight Wolfpacks. Each Wolfpack deals around 750 damage, totaling ~6000 damage, easily exceeding the 3-star requirement. This is costly but effective.
  • Method 2 (Risky): Get on top of the 女王/女族长 and place Deadline mines. This can deal significant damage but is highly dangerous.
  • Method 3 (Recommended): Use a Jupiter instead of a Hullcracker. The Jupiter deals greatly more damage per shot and its ammo is cheaper to 制作/buy. This method allows for faster damage accumulation.
  • Safe Positioning: When engaging the 女王/女族长, find high ground or cover.
  • Group Play: This trial is best completed in a trio. If other teams join the fight, they will steal damage points from you, making it harder to reach the 3-star threshold. Coordinate with your team to deal the damage and secure the kill entirely for yourselves.

title: 反转
content:
概述

The 'Turnabout' 任务 asks you to get the 太空港 Trench Tower Key, head over to the North Trench Tower, find and upload the blackmail files to 塞莱斯特, and then successfully 撤离 from the area.

步骤一: Prepare Your 装备方案

  • Make sure you have equipped an augment that includes at least one 安全口袋 in your 装备方案. [SCREENSHOT:00:15]
  • Place the '太空港 Trench Tower Key' (provided by the 任务) into your 安全口袋 for safekeeping.
  • Note: If you happen to lose the key, there is replacements by 搜刮 containers like drawers, cupboards, and lockers across any 地图.

步骤二: Head Toward North Trench Tower

  • Once spawned into 太空港, check your 地图 and spot the 'North Trench Tower' located in the far northeast section of the 地图.
  • While the 任务 key can open either the North or South Trench Tower, your objective in certain requires entry into the North Trench Tower.

步骤三: Enter the Tower

  • Go to the North Trench Tower from 'The Trench' area.
  • Find the external stairs leading up to an underground floor entrance. Climb these stairs.
  • Go through the underground section, going up internal stairs to reach the surface level of the tower.
  • On the surface, find one of the two main doors. 互动 to unlock and open it.

步骤四: Upload Blackmail Files

  • After going into the tower, navigate through the first floor. There aren't any key objectives here, but you can search 破解 boxes for 搜刮.
  • Find and climb the stairs leading up to the second floor.
  • On the second floor, find a computer station positioned in the center, on the northeastern side of the room.
  • Use the computer to upload the blackmail files.

步骤五: 撤离 and Claim Rewards

  • After uploading the files, all that remains is to successfully 撤离 from the mission area.
  • Head back to 塞莱斯特 at your base to hand in the 任务 and claim your rewards.

title: 11月17日周试炼
content:
概述

In this guide, we explain tips for excelling in the weekly trials from November 17th to 23rd, centered on specific objectives like harvesting plants, opening ARC probes, damaging flying ARC enemies, and damaging leapers. Pay attention to major 地图 conditions for 2x points to maximize your score.

Used this video by Ebontis to make this guide

步骤一: Harvest Plants

For the 'Harvest Plants' trial, you must harvest specific plant types like mushrooms, Great Mullein, or moss that have a fill-up bar, not just regular pickups.

  • Mushrooms are generally unreliable to find.
  • Some moss is in the Hydroponic Dome Complex in 大坝战场.
  • **Best location:** 地下城, in certain the Galleria on a 夜间突袭 condition.
  • You can find many Great Mullein plants in planters and lobbies, offering about 500 points each (about 26-30 per run).

步骤二: Open ARC Probes

For the 'Open ARC Probes' trial, you'll want to target probes with a ring around them that require 互动ion to open. ARC Couriers usually do not count.

  • Choose larger 地图s with 2x point conditions, such as 隐藏地堡, to get more time (40 minutes instead of 30).
  • Each probe is worth around 1334 points, so opening three on a 夜间突袭 will usually secure your 4000 points.
  • You can get lucky with multiple probes spawning close together, like the example of three probes near the 破解 on 大坝战场 during an 电磁风暴.
  • To open a probe, you must 破解 it open and then examine the container.

步骤三: Damage Flying ARC Enemies

This broad trial includes various flying enemies like 黄蜂, 勘测者, 告密者es, 大黄蜂, and 火箭兵.

  • For efficiency, consider using a **Hullcracker** (launcher weapon) as it has very strong ARC armor penetration.
  • The Hullcracker costs 30,000 currency and can be purchased once every 24 hours. Stock up on Launcher Ammo.
  • When targeting 火箭兵, focus fire on one side to disable two engines quickly, bringing them down.
  • Use **告密者 Scanners** to call in more enemies, featuring flying ones, to increase your damage output and points.
  • Hullcracker can often one-shot 黄蜂 and 大黄蜂.

步骤四: Damage 跳跃者

跳跃者 are exposed to fire damage.

  • Use **Blaze Grenades** to set the ground on fire when 跳跃者 jump at you or are stationary.
  • **火球 Burners** (from 火球) can also be effective.
  • The **Snap Blast Grenade** is recommended because it sticks to enemies, making it easier to deal consistent damage.
  • The **Heavy Fuse Grenade** is an alternative but less reliable due to 跳跃者' movement.
  • The **Deadline mine** is really good if you can attach it to a 跳跃者, dealing a significant amount of damage.
  • Try running missions with an 电磁风暴 condition, as 跳跃者 seem to be more common.
  • 隐藏地堡 missions offer longer time (40 minutes) to find and defeat 跳跃者.

步骤五: Damage 女王 or 女族长

This trial has you damage either 女王 or 女族长, which usually appear as specific 地图 conditions.

  • Right now, no 女王 or 女族长 missions are active, but keep an eye out for them in areas like 太空港 or 隐藏地堡.
